mapper.sql: SELECT o.id,o.stocktake_no,o.company_id,d.dept_name company_name,o.project_id,o.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,o.stocktake_type,o.scope_type,o.zone_id,z.zone_name,o.location_id,l.location_name,o.status,o.stocktake_at,o.confirmed_at,o.completed_at,o.cancelled_at,o.operator_id,u.nick_name operator_name,o.create_time,o.remark FROM wm_stocktake_order o LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=o.company_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_zone z ON z.id=o.zone_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_location l ON l.id=o.location_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=o.operator_id

WHERE o.del_flag='0' AND o.warehouse_id IN #{id} AND o.stocktake_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.stocktakeNo},'%') AND o.warehouse_id=#{bo.warehouseId} AND o.status=#{bo.status} AND o.stocktake_type=#{bo.stocktakeType} AND o.stocktake_at>=#{bo.beginStocktakeAt} AND o.stocktake_at<=#{bo.endStocktakeAt}
